hero.description: I'm Enzo, a Software Engineering student building a long-term technology ecosystem focused on Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Data Engineering.

about.title: Meet Enzo
about.description: Passionate about building modern digital systems and exploring the future of technology through practical projects. NEXUS is the ecosystem where software engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and data engineering come together to create long-term solutions.

purpose.title: Why NEXUS Exists
purpose.description: NEXUS wasn't created to be just another portfolio. It was designed to become a technology ecosystem that grows alongside my career, connecting projects, research, laboratories and future innovations into a single platform.
